1. Engagement Scope

This review was conducted at the request of Fillmore Advisory executive leadership to assess compliance with applicable federal and state employment regulations governing compensation practices across 7 operating locations. The review period covers fiscal year 2018 through Q3 2020, encompassing 202 active employee records across all job families.

2. Methodology

ACPWB conducted a simulation of a mass layoff event to test the operational readiness of Fillmore Advisory's HR and legal teams to comply with WARN Act notification requirements under a compressed timeline.

4. Detailed Findings
DPA-2201-001MEDIUMMONITORING
Observation

ACA Form 1095-C contains incorrect offer of coverage codes for 202 full-time employees

Corrective Action Required

Conduct a privileged pay equity analysis under the direction of outside counsel to identify and remediate any statistically significant pay disparities based on gender or race/ethnicity.

Management Response

Management acknowledges the finding and has initiated a preliminary review. The designated owner will oversee remediation. Fillmore Advisory requests a 30-day extension to the original due date to allow for thorough analysis across all affected locations.

Owner: Project Manager • Due: 2018-05-28
DPA-5961-002LOWREMEDIATED
Observation

10b5-1 trading plan for 202 executives lacks required cooling-off period under amended rules

Corrective Action Required

Automate the COBRA notification process to ensure qualifying event notices are generated and mailed within 5 business days of the triggering event.

Management Response

The finding is accepted. We have implemented a manual control as an interim solution while a permanent system fix is being developed. The manual control is performed daily by the compliance team.

Owner: Director of Market Research • Due: 2018-05-28
DPA-9084-003HIGHDEFERRED
Observation

Documentation gaps in personnel files for 202 employees — required for audit trail compliance

Corrective Action Required

Distribute updated HIPAA privacy notices to all new and existing health plan participants within 30 days. Incorporate notice distribution into the standard new hire and open enrollment onboarding process.

Management Response

The finding is noted. This issue stems from a lack of clarity in the regulatory guidance. We have submitted a formal inquiry to the regulatory agency and are awaiting their response before proceeding with a final corrective action.

Owner: Senior Director of Stakeholder Engagement • Due: 2018-02-28
DPA-2711-004LOWIN PROGRESS
Observation

Compensation equity variance exceeds 15% threshold across protected class segments

Corrective Action Required

Fillmore Advisory shall conduct a full pay equity analysis across all protected class segments within 45 days of report issuance and submit a remediation plan to ACPWB for review.

Management Response

This finding relates to a legacy system that is scheduled for decommissioning on 2018-01-09. Given the impending system retirement, management has accepted the risk for the interim period and will not invest in remediation for the legacy system.

Owner: Chief Legal Officer • Due: 2018-04-28
DPA-8132-005LOWREMEDIATED
Observation

Union information requests for bargaining unit data were not fulfilled within the required timeframe

Corrective Action Required

The process for identifying the median employee will be enhanced to include a statistical sampling approach, with the methodology and results documented and presented to the Audit Committee.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. A cross-functional task force has been assembled to address the root cause. An initial project plan and timeline will be submitted to ACPWB within 15 days.

Owner: Director of Revenue Operations • Due: 2018-03-28
